en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 6. Muḥammad ibn Hammām ibn Suhayl narrated to me from Ja’far ibn Muḥammad ibn Mālik Al-Fazāri, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥamdān Al-Madā`ini, from Ziyād Al-Qandi, who said: Abul Ḥasan Mūsā (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)) said to me, “

I love for you that which I love for myself and I hate for you that which I hate for myself. Establish prayers in full form in the two Ḥarams, in (the Mosque of) Kūfah, and next to the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.).”
